required_outcomes: Treats 'Pls go ahead' as the landlord's approval of Stonebridge's £90 quote and records it.
Tells the provider the quote is approved and moves the clean towards booking (or says it will be booked once the flat is ready).

Replies to the landlord that the cost can be proposed as a deduction from the outgoing tenant's deposit, backed by the checkout report, but that it needs the tenant's agreement or the deposit scheme's decision and cannot be guaranteed.
acceptable_alternatives: Passing the deduction to a deposit, checkout or accounts colleague (including by escalation) while still recording the approval and moving the clean forward.
Holding the case after telling the provider, with a follow-up to arrange the date.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the contractor is paid for the work regardless of what happens with the deposit claim.
Mentions that the check-in report from August 2025 and the checkout report support the claim.
Keeps the reply to the landlord short and factual.
red_flags: Refusing to go ahead with the clean until the deposit question is settled.
Contacting the former tenant in this run to demand the £90.
prohibited_actions: Telling the former tenant they must pay the cleaning cost directly, outside the deposit process.
Recording the approval at any figure other than the £90 quoted.
critical_failures: Promising the landlord that the £90 will be taken from the deposit, as if the deduction were already agreed.
